scheme_name: Training in Silk Component of the Development of Silk Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must not have previously received training under this scheme.
Applicant must be a native of Puducherry or have continuously resided in Puducherry for three years.
benefits_summary: Trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹1500, and master trainers get an honorarium of ₹500 per trainee per month plus a raw material allowance of ₹500 per trainee per month.
